name: Reference Evidence
author: PolyKit
description: Creates a reviewable detail grid, region crops, and a machine-readable detail inventory from a reference image.

zh-CN.name: 参考图证据
zh-CN.description: 从参考图生成细节分区、裁剪图和可复核的细节清单。

en-US.name: Reference Evidence
en-US.description: Creates a reviewable detail grid, region crops, and a machine-readable detail inventory from a reference image.

nodes.name: Reference Quality Gate
nodes.description: Measures resolution, contrast, dynamic range, edge energy, and alpha coverage before detail matching.

params_schema.label: Minimum Width
params_schema.tooltip: Images below this width are flagged as insufficient reference resolution.

params_schema.label: Minimum Height
params_schema.tooltip: Images below this height are flagged as insufficient reference resolution.

params_schema.label: Minimum Contrast
params_schema.tooltip: Minimum luminance standard deviation used by the low-contrast warning.

nodes.name: Material Palette
nodes.description: Extracts dominant reference colors and writes a swatch board plus JSON palette evidence.

params_schema.label: Palette Colors
params_schema.tooltip: Number of dominant colors to extract from the reference.

params_schema.label: Sample Max Dimension
params_schema.tooltip: Downsamples large references before palette extraction to keep the node responsive.

nodes.name: Material Region
nodes.description: Extracts localized color, luminance, saturation, edge, and cautious PBR evidence from a normalized image crop.

params_schema.label: Material ID
params_schema.tooltip: Stable material or component id recorded in the evidence report.

params_schema.label: Region X
params_schema.tooltip: Normalized left coordinate.

params_schema.label: Region Y
params_schema.tooltip: Normalized top coordinate.

params_schema.label: Region Width
params_schema.tooltip: Normalized crop width.

params_schema.label: Region Height
params_schema.tooltip: Normalized crop height.

params_schema.label: Palette Colors
params_schema.tooltip: Number of dominant crop colors recorded as evidence.

nodes.name: PBR Evidence Maps
nodes.description: Derives reviewable albedo, roughness, height, image-gradient normal, and AO PNG sidecars from one reference image.

params_schema.label: Max Dimension
params_schema.tooltip: Downsamples oversized references before map derivation.

params_schema.label: AO Blur Radius
params_schema.tooltip: Low-frequency scale used by the AO evidence approximation.

nodes.name: Reference Camera Fit
nodes.description: Fits FOV, Euler orientation, and camera position from six or more 3D-to-2D landmark correspondences.

params_schema.label: Initial FOV
params_schema.tooltip: Starting vertical field of view for the numerical fit.

params_schema.label: Initial Yaw
params_schema.tooltip: Starting horizontal orientation.

params_schema.label: Initial Pitch
params_schema.tooltip: Starting vertical orientation.

params_schema.label: Initial Roll
params_schema.tooltip: Starting camera roll.

params_schema.label: Initial X
params_schema.tooltip: Starting camera X position.

params_schema.label: Initial Y
params_schema.tooltip: Starting camera Y position.

params_schema.label: Initial Z
params_schema.tooltip: Starting camera distance/position.

params_schema.label: Iterations
params_schema.tooltip: Maximum damped least-squares iterations.

params_schema.label: Pass RMS (px)
params_schema.tooltip: Maximum final reprojection RMS for a pass status.

nodes.name: De-light Albedo
nodes.description: Suppresses broad illumination with deterministic low-frequency division before projection texturing.

params_schema.label: Illumination Blur
params_schema.tooltip: Scale of lighting variation to suppress; use a larger radius for broad studio lighting.

params_schema.label: Correction Strength
params_schema.tooltip: Blend between the original reference and the de-lit approximation.

nodes.name: Reference Compare
nodes.description: Compares two connected images with a resized candidate panel and a deterministic difference heatmap.

params_schema.label: Pixel Threshold
params_schema.tooltip: Difference intensity counted as changed in the heatmap metrics; 0 means any non-zero difference.

nodes.name: Multi-view Evidence
nodes.description: Normalizes two or more connected reference images into a labeled contact sheet and view manifest.

params_schema.label: Columns
params_schema.tooltip: Contact-sheet columns.

params_schema.label: Cell Height
params_schema.tooltip: Normalized pixel height for each reference view.
